international.title: All hostages freed after Colombian security forces storm supermarket, says president
international.summary: Operation in which one captor was killed brings to an end day-long siege in which 30 hostages were initially held Colombian security forces have stormed a supermarket in the Caribbean city of Cartagena to end a day-long hostage siege , with the president saying all hostages have been rescued and one captor killed. Abelardo de la Espriella said: “In an extraordinary joint operation between the national police and the armed forces, all the hostages were rescued.” Continue reading...
